title: 第三章 骗子
content_zh:
“这星落城哪个地方信息最灵通咱去哪。”

    “六少爷是要去珍宝阁了？”

    “珍宝阁？”

    见主子疑惑，石头特有眼力见的将珍宝阁的情况作了介绍，珍宝阁就是星落城最大的商品交易中心，里边功法、武器、丹药一应俱全，而且品质皆为不俗，同时也具有完备的情报系统，可以说只要你有钱，珍宝阁可以满足你的任何需求。

    听完石头的汇报，任天一颇为满意，任天一重生，需要尽快和尽可能全面的了解自己的生存环境，而珍宝阁无疑是最合适的去处，随即主仆二人朝珍宝阁奔去。

    一直以来，任天一鲜少出门，人们只听说任家六公子痴傻，鲜有人见过他的真容，所以此时任天一出现在大街上，并没有人认出他。

    一路上，石头一直偷偷打量着任天一，此时的任天一淡定从容，身上散发着一种鲜有的自信，根本没有了往日的傻态，对于此时的主子石头发自内心的敬畏，用心的伺候着。

    一路上，任天一默默的观察着周围的一切，他不由皱起了眉头。

    “周围的这些人身上的气势平平，莫非武道真的没落了？”

    不多时，两人就来到了珍宝阁。

    珍宝阁是由六处大殿合围而建，大殿气势恢宏，威严而大器，无不彰显着珍宝阁不凡的地位。

    “六少爷，您出门可曾带金币了吗？”    两人刚要进殿，石头突然开口道。

    “金币？”任天一愕然，前世身为丹道至尊，从来不缺也不关心钱财，以至于他根本没有注意到此时他身无分文。

    所谓一分钱难倒英雄汉，任天一不禁有些气短。

    说话间，正有一位靓丽的少女搀扶着一位老妇从大殿中走出来，少女身材高挑，面凝鹅脂，唇若点樱，双眸灵动有神，一身鹅黄长裙裹身，勾勒出凹凸有致的曲线，尽显青春气息，只是她双眉紧锁，满面愁容。

    “姑娘不必再为我发愁了，老婆子我活到现在已经很知足了，能看到姑娘长大成人也能给你娘有个交代了。”老妇拍拍少女手背，缓缓说道，只是她眼中流露出难掩的失落之色。

    “阁主柳伯父也说了或许永生殿会有办法治好您这病，只要有一线希望，我就不会放弃，不管是什么代价。”少女双眸噙泪，执拗的说道。

    老妇一声长叹，不再言语。
content_en:
"Which place in Xingluo City has the best information should we go to."

    "Sixth Young Master is going to the Treasure Pavilion?"

    "Jinbao Pavilion?"

    Seeing his master's doubts, Shitou introduced the situation of Zhenbao Pavilion with his unique insight. Zhenbao Pavilion is the largest commodity trading center in Xingluo City. It contains all kinds of skills, weapons, and elixirs, and the quality is good. It also has a complete intelligence system. It can be said that as long as you have money, Zhenbao Pavilion can meet any of your needs.

    After listening to Shitou's report, Ren Tianyi was quite satisfied. After Ren Tianyi was reborn, he needed to understand his living environment as quickly and as comprehensively as possible, and the Treasure Pavilion was undoubtedly the most suitable place. Then the master and the servant ran towards the Treasure Pavilion.

    For a long time, Ren Tianyi rarely went out. People only heard that the sixth young master of the Ren family was stupid, and few people had seen his true face. So when Ren Tianyi appeared on the street, no one recognized him.

    Along the way, Shi Tou kept secretly sizing up Ren Tianyi. At this time, Ren Tianyi was calm and calm, exuding a rare confidence. He was no longer as stupid as before. He was in awe of his master, Shi Tou, and served him attentively.

    Along the way, Ren Tianyi silently observed everything around him, and he couldn't help but frown.

    "The aura of these people around me is mediocre. Could it be that martial arts has really declined?"

    Not long after, the two arrived at the Treasure Pavilion.

    Zhenbao Pavilion is built surrounded by six main halls. The grand halls are majestic, majestic and powerful, all of which demonstrate the extraordinary status of Zhenbao Pavilion.

    "Sixth Young Master, did you take any gold coins with you when you went out?" Just as the two were about to enter the palace, Shitou suddenly spoke.

    "Gold coins?" Ren Tian was stunned. In his previous life, he was the supreme alchemist. He never lacked or cared about money, so he didn't even notice that he was penniless at this time.

    As the saying goes, a penny can stump a heroic man, Ren Tianyi couldn't help but feel short of breath.

    While they were talking, a beautiful girl was helping an old woman walk out of the hall. The girl was tall, with a smooth face, lips like cherry blossoms, and lively eyes. She was wrapped in a long goose-yellow skirt that outlined her curves, showing her youthful atmosphere. However, her eyebrows were furrowed and her face was filled with sadness.

    "Girl, you don't have to worry about me anymore. Old lady, I'm very content with my life. I can see the girl grow up and give your mother an explanation." The old woman patted the back of the girl's hand and said slowly, but there was an unconcealable look of disappointment in her eyes.

    "Uncle Liu, the Pavilion Master, also said that maybe the Eternal Life Palace will have a way to cure your disease. As long as there is a glimmer of hope, I will not give up, no matter what the cost." The girl said stubbornly with tears in her eyes.

    The old woman sighed and said nothing.
